text:
Maya Patel: Quick micro-review of compare UI: filter chip ordering, pin placement in compact view, and perf badge verbosity. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-mini.png
Omar Singh: +1 to user-ordered chips. Provide a simple drag affordance and remember order per-session.
Leah Cho: For pins, move the pin toggle into the left column next to model name so it never disappears in dense rows. Make it a toggle button with clear aria-label.
Kara Gomez: Accessibility notes: keyboard reordering (ctrl+arrow), aria-live updates for chip order, aria-pressed for pin, and ensure perf badge details are reachable by focus (not hover-only).
Maya Patel: Perf badges: collapse to single "Perf p95" badge by default, expand on focus to show p50/p99. Also add aria-label like "p95 120ms, up 25% vs baseline".
Omar Singh: I'll add localStorage persistence for chip order and filters.
Leah Cho: Microcopy: change "Compact" tooltip to "Compact view 1 denser rows" for first-time users.
ux-bot: Created ticket RD-INF-4801 and added owners.
Maya Patel: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
